'''Civé Rashon''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[TIE pilot]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She led [[Obsidian Squadron/Legends|Obsidian Squadron]], an elite [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] stationed aboard the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Avenger/Legends|''Avenger'']], and Rashon flew the [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]] [[Obsidian 1]] in her capacity as lead [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]. In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Rashon led Obsidian Squadron at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], which resulted in an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] defeat by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].

==Biography==
The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]]<ref name="SWG" /> Civé Rashon served as a [[TIE pilot]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] fought between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. She became the lead [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of [[Obsidian Squadron/Legends|Obsidian Squadron]], an elite [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] that served aboard the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Avenger/Legends|''Avenger'']]. In her capacity as lead pilot of Obsidian Squadron, Rashon flew the [[TIE series/Legends|TIE/LN]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Obsidian 1]], which had the designation of OS-72-1, and operated under the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of "Howlrunner," a name shared with<ref name="CCG1" /> the wild, [[Diet/Legends|omnivorous]] [[Howlrunner/Legends|howlrunner]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamar/Legends|Kamar]].<ref name="Howlrunner">{{CSWECite|II|64|Howlrunner}}</ref> Rashon's [[Wingmate/Legends|wingman]] was [[Dodson Makraven/Legends|Dodson Makraven]], who flew [[Obsidian 2]].<ref name="CCG2">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=OS-72-2 In Obsidian 2}}</ref> At one point during her service, Rashon flew Obsidian 1 over [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]<ref name="CCG1" /> on the planet [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]].<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref>

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars Galaxies}}
[[File:Obsidian_1.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Civé Rashon's Obsidian 1]]
Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]<ref name="SWG" /> of [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] and the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref> Rashon served under Imperial [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Zhanks]], and partook in a skirmish against at least one [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]]. She was defeated in the fight, but managed to escape alive in her crippled TIE/LN starfighter. Rashon also participated in battles between Rebel and Imperial forces in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian]], [[Dantooine system/Legends|Dantooine]], [[Karthakk system|Karthakk]], [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo]], and [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo systems]] during the Galactic Civil War. The battles involved an Imperial [[Lancer-class frigate/Legends|''Lancer''-class frigate]] being pitted against a Rebel [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]], with numerous starfighters aiding in the defense or offense of the [[Star system/Legends|star systems]].<ref name="SWG" />
{{Endgame}}

In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="NEC" /> Rashon led Obsidian Squadron at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]],<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|81|Rashon, Civé}}</ref> in which the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] attacked the Imperial [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] in the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]]. The battle ended with an Imperial defeat and the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star's]] destruction.<ref name="RotJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
When engaging the Rebel pilot in battle during their post-Battle of Yavin skirmish, Civé Rashon expressed determination to destroy her opponent. She had [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and light skin.<ref name="SWG" />

==Equipment==
Civé Rashon wore a black [[Imperial Navy crewman|Imperial Navy crewwoman's]] [[Imperial military uniforms/Legends|uniform]]<ref name="SWG" /> with the standard TIE pilot [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]].<ref name="Armada">{{Armada|set=Core Set|cardname="Howlrunner"|subtitle=TIE Fighter Squadron}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|You have damaged my ship, but I can still destroy you!|One of Civé Rashon's possible quotes if her fighter is damaged|<ref name="SWG" />}}
Civé Rashon's origins lie with a TIE/LN starfighter prop with a TIE pilot in the cockpit for the [[1980]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']].<ref name="SWC">''[[Star Wars Chronicles]]''</ref> She was brought into the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity for a card in the [[1998]] ''[[Special Edition Limited]]'' expansion set of [[Decipher]]'s [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]],<ref name="CCG1" /> while being simultaneously mentioned on Dodson Makraven's card for the same set.<ref name="CCG2" />

[[File:CiveRashon.png|right|thumb|Civé Rashon as she appeared in ''Star Wars Galaxies'']]
In the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', Rashon was added to the game as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in its [[W:c:swg:Game Update 20|Game Update 20]],<ref name="SWG" /> published on [[August 18]], [[2011]].<ref name="GU20">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=69206&month=082011|text=Star Wars Galaxies: Hotfix 20 -- Thursday, August 18, 2011}}</ref> In the game, the name Civé did not have an accentuated letter E. Rebel players who requested [[W:c:swg:Tier|Tier 7]] [[W:c:swg:Destroy Duty Missions|Duty Missions]] from certain [[Space station/Legends|space stations]] had a chance to battle an [[W:c:swg:Ace Pilot System|elite Imperial pilot]] during the mission's boss stage. One of these pilots could be Rashon. All of the elite Imperial pilots, Rashon included, had shared quotes randomly generated during the battle. If the player defeated her, she was not destroyed. Instead, a message was displayed to the player indicating that they successfully defeated the pilot, and they were awarded with a [[W:c:swg:Collection|collection]] icon as well.<ref name="SWG" />

Elite Imperial pilots also flew in various [[Realspace/Legends|space]] battles, which took place in the Corellian, Dantooine, Karthakk, Naboo, and Tatoo systems. As Rashon only appeared in the space portion of ''Star Wars Galaxies'', originally added with the [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] expansion pack, she could normally only be seen inside her respective TIE/LN starfighter. However, a [[Comm unit/Legends|comm]] display could appear during the battle that displayed the character's face in addition to the collection icon the player was rewarded for defeating her. Although players could choose not to participate in any of the battles or collections connected to Rashon, this article assumes 100% game completion.<ref name="SWG" />
